Magma Heart Quirk.name: Magma Heart Quirk
Magma Heart Quirk.description:
🌋 Stone you raise arrives hot, and heat you make melts rock: you turn stone into slag and back again.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Earth and Fire: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you tip up a waist-high slab of hot pavement for cover and blister the stone under a foe's feet.
📈 With training: smoking ridges, locks melted by touch, hot mud traps, poured rock cooled into cuffs and barricades, rubble fused into a glassy rescue ramp, and a heated floor.
⚠️ Heat lingers in every surface you work: cool it before civilians touch it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as heat builds inside your palms and chest.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Cementoss (Cement), for shaping only.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Warm Slab, Slag Glaze
🛡️ Resists: fire
Magma Heart Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user heats and shapes stone, concrete, brick and asphalt by touch. A new adult user moves half a car's weight of stone within two meters in a couple of seconds and can cool it back to touchable. Limits: touch on stone, concrete or soil only; wood, glass, metal and air never answer (steel decks, midair). Worked stone stays hot for minutes unless quenched, burning civilians; quenching dumps heat into the user. Quirk Strain: light: warm slab, blistered floor; moderate: smoking ridge, melted lock, hot mud trap, cooled cuffs, glassy ramp; heavy: clamping slabs; severe: signature wave, heated courtyard. Fusion: Earth plus Fire; half an Earth user's reach and volume; no flames or ranged blasts (heat moves only through rock); only the fusion melts stone to slag, fuses rubble to glass and quenches it solid. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed melting of roads or walls is property damage; hot stone left for the public is negligence. Look: orange-veined, hissing rock.
